map_info.name: Naples Street Museum
map_info.description: A museum inspired by walking through Naples — rooms represent different buildings and sites you would visit, from Gesu Nuovo to Pompeii villas to Florentine facades.

learning_objectives: Compare architectural styles across Neapolitan sites
Observe how floor patterns encode cultural computation
Experience facade presets as freestanding exhibits
